abilities.name: Seating Chart Read
abilities.description: Read where people sit at a feast and know who is rising in favor and who is falling.
abilities.cost: Only at a formal table; needs a full course to read

growth.grows: how subtle a shift you notice

abilities.name: Perfect Curtsy
abilities.description: You can greet anyone of higher rank so flawlessly that they cannot take offense at what you say next.

growth.grows: how bold a sentence you can get away with

abilities.name: Fan Language
abilities.description: Signal a message across a ballroom with a fan or glove that only your allies can read.
abilities.cost: Needs an ally who knows the code

abilities.name: Poisoner's Palate
abilities.description: Taste a dish and sense whether anything in it should not be there.
abilities.cost: You still swallow a little of what is in it

growth.grows: how subtle a poison you catch

abilities.name: Favor Ledger
abilities.description: Recall exactly who owes whom a favor at court, if you have heard it spoken of once.
abilities.cost: Remembering everyone's favors makes you trust no one

growth.grows: how many favors and how far back

abilities.name: Servant's Invisibility
abilities.description: When you carry a tray or basket, guards and nobles look through you for as long as you keep moving.
abilities.cost: Stop moving and you are seen at once

growth.grows: how guarded a room you can walk through

abilities.name: Letter Seal Lift
abilities.description: With a warm knife you can lift a wax seal and press it back so the reader never knows it was opened.
abilities.cost: Takes a quiet quarter hour; old seals may crack

abilities.name: Heir's Bearing
abilities.description: Stand and speak like royalty so commoners obey you without asking who you are, until a real noble arrives.
abilities.cost: Lying about your blood is treason if caught

growth.grows: how important the people who obey

abilities.name: Rumor Seeding
abilities.description: Tell one courtier a rumor and you can hear it reach the person you aimed it at within a day.

growth.grows: how far and how fast it spreads

abilities.name: Portrait Smile
abilities.description: Hold a pleasant expression through any insult, so no one can read what you really feel.
abilities.cost: Jaw aches; the anger has to go somewhere later

growth.grows: how cruel an insult you can stand

abilities.name: Bloodline Memory
abilities.description: Name any noble house and you can recall its arms, its feuds and its marriages.

growth.grows: how minor a house you know

abilities.name: Hidden Passage Sense
abilities.description: Walk the corridors of an old palace and sense where a servants' passage or hidden door runs.
abilities.cost: Only palaces older than a century

growth.grows: how well hidden a passage you find
